text:
maria: Quick sync before we flip the A/B price sheet. Two edge cases: customers who downgraded within 14 days of T0, and partner-billed accounts that need a visible relief option.

josh: For downgrades my tilt is to exclude automatic grandfathering if downgrade_date <= T0 + 14d. Flag them `downgrade_review`. Manual ops review only.

kevin: Agreed. Also want to limit automatic small credits < $75 to avoid mailing. Anything above $75 goes to finance review queue.

tara: Partner-billed customers: we can't change partner invoices. Proposal: issue a platform promo credit (non-ledger) up to $50 for immediate relief AND handoff CSV to partner-ops requesting partner refund for the financial credit.

maria: Good compromise. Add `promo_issued=true` for partner rows. Also include `partner_passthrough=true` and `partner_contact` in the export.

josh: I'll build the cohort SQL and include fields: customer_id, subscription_id, billing_country, created_at, downgrade_date, partner_passthrough, estimated_credit_usd, estimated_vat_usd, promo_issued.

kevin: Need an estimated exposure summary at top-level: sum of estimated_credit_usd and count of rows by |platform|partner. We need that number before rolling to canary.

billing-bot: Export scheduled at 00:45 UTC. Will post csv to https://internal.redwood/exports/2018004321-ab-grandfather-exposure.csv and message #eng-billing when done.

maria: Action items: Josh run export and tag `experiment_ab=canary` (due EOD). Kevin draft finance thresholds doc (auto-credit cap $75, refund threshold $5,000). Tara prepare partner handoff template + promo wording.

josh: SQL snippet:```sql
select s.customer_id, s.id as subscription_id, s.created_at, s.downgrade_date,
       case when p.marketplace is not null then true else false end as partner_passthrough,
       -- simple est: last_month_usage_tokens * (old_rate - new_rate)
       (select sum(usage_tokens) from invoice_lines where subscription_id = s.id and period=@last_month) * (old_rate - new_rate) as estimated_credit_usd
from subscriptions s
left join partners p on s.partner_id = p.id
where s.status='active' and s.created_at < '2026-04-01'
```

maria: Keep customer messaging simple: "We adjusted pricing as part of a limited experiment. If you qualify, a credit will appear on your next invoice or as a small account promo. Questions: billing@redwood.com"

kevin: OK. If export shows exposure < $50k for canary and no major tax country concentration we'll proceed. Locking policy at 16:00 PT if no objections.

tara: I'll ready partner template and include suggested phrasing: "We recommend issuing a refund for invoice #INV-XXXX or confirming partner promo within 5 business days."

billing-bot: Job started 00:47 UTC  312 rows tagged and export uploaded. File: https://internal.redwood/exports/2018004321-ab-grandfather-exposure.csv
